passages.title: My First Spacewalk
passages.text: I will never forget my first spacewalk. Before I left the spacecraft, I had to put on a heavy (1)____ to protect me from the cold. Working without gravity was not (7)____, because my tools kept trying to drift away from my hands. After two hours, I was (8)____ but happy. passages.title: Breakfast Without Gravity
passages.text: Eating breakfast in space is stranger than you might (1)____. Because there is almost no gravity, the food does not stay on the plate but tries to (2)____ into the air. passages.title: Eyes in the Sky
passages.text: High above our heads, thousands of satellites quietly (1)____ around the Earth. Many people think they are useful only for phones, but they do far (2)____ than that. passages.title: The Problem of Space Junk
passages.text: Every time a rocket is launched, it can leave small pieces of metal behind in space. Over the years, these pieces have (1)____ into a huge cloud of rubbish that we call space junk. Cleaning up space will not be (8)____, but it is important for the future. After all, we do not want the road to the stars to become (9)____ with our own rubbish. Keeping space (10)____ is a job for the whole world to share.
